map.offline.about: Bring a regional basemap as one .pmtiles file: every map then draws from it, with no request to a tile server, and its labels follow the app's language.
map.offline.none: No offline map in the vault. Maps show online tiles only if you allow them (never in airplane mode).
map.offline.title: Offline map
map.offline.where: Where to get one: Protomaps publishes the whole world as one file; cut a region with the pmtiles tool, for example:
map.tiles.why: Off until you allow it: the tiles tell tile.openstreetmap.org which area you are viewing. An offline map in the vault needs no network.
